units.source_text: 源氏大将看到这尚侍如此容易接近，却怀念起和她相反的藤壶皇后来。

en.t: When General Genji saw how approachable this Naishi no Kami was, he began to long for Empress Fujitsubo, who was just the opposite of her.

units.source_text: 藤壶皇后冷酷无情，拒人于千里之外，他觉得深可敬佩。

en.t: Empress Fujitsubo was cold and unyielding, keeping people at a great distance, and he felt that this was deeply worthy of admiration.

units.source_text: 但从他自己的愿望说来，终觉得这个人心肠太硬，实在可恨。

en.t: Yet from the point of view of his own desires, he still felt in the end that she was too hard-hearted, and truly hateful.
